items.source: This class (and PatchOperation capture the definition of a patch, but are not coupled to any specific patch representation.
items.translation: 该类（以及PatchOperation）用于捕获补丁的定义，但并未与任何特定的补丁表示形式耦合。

items.source: Applies the Patch to a given List of objects.
items.translation: 将补丁应用于给定的对象列表。

items.source: Applies the Patch to a given Object graph.
items.translation: 将补丁应用于给定的对象图。

items.source:
Applies the Patch to a given Object graph. Makes a copy of the given object so that it will remain unchanged after
application of the patch and in case any errors occur while performing the patch.
items.translation: 将补丁应用于给定的对象图。会对给定对象进行复制，以确保在应用补丁后对象保持不变，并且在执行补丁过程中发生任何错误时也能保持原状。

items.source:
Applies the Patch to a given List of objects. Makes a copy of the given list so that it will remain unchanged after
application of the patch and in case any errors occur while performing the patch.
items.translation: 将补丁应用于给定的对象列表。该方法会创建给定列表的副本，以确保在应用补丁后列表保持不变，并且在执行补丁过程中发生任何错误时也能保持原状。

items.translation: iterator 在接口 Iterable<PatchOperation> 中
